verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Lean measures the error against U_* = 4η + j_0 (`NaturalAxisData.U j η = 4η + j`) instead of against 4η, and correspondingly carries no C_k j_0 term on the right. The rewriting: ∂_η^n(U_* − 4η) equals j_0 for n = 0 and 0 for n ≥ 1, so the triangle inequality turns the Lean bound into the paper's with C_k = 1 and the same C_k^nat, C_k^join, and conversely. The remaining correspondences: J = Icc (−1) 1 is the paper's η ∈ [−1,1]; the orders n ≤ N are the prescribed finite collection of η-derivative orders; the width slot T + κ + w₁ + w₂ is t_1 + κ_0 + ω_fin with ω_fin the sum of the two final widths; Cnat is chosen before Λ and Cjoin after Λ, matching C_k^nat and C_k^join(Λ). One direction of strength: Lean's Cnat and Cjoin are single constants valid for all n ≤ N, where the paper writes order-dependent C_k.
